intro.text: The Takers seems to be what Tukks's squad, a unit of Alethi soldiers in Amaram's army, was called.
The Takers appears to be the name of Tukks's squad in Amaram's army, the first squad Kaladin served in after joining up late in 1168.

description.text: Their sergeant, Tukks, taught that a soldier has to keep caring while he fights instead of shutting his feelings away.
The squad was made up of darkeyed spearmen. Away from battle they trained new recruits with spear and quarterstaff, keeping discipline through cleaning duty and corporal punishment.

items.text: With the Takers, Kaladin turned his natural talent with the spear into real skill.
Most or all of the squad died, and Kaladin was moved elsewhere. He regretted being unable to save them and often thought back on Tukks's ideas about fighting with purpose.
